name: Flow Sponsored Transactions (Gas Abstraction Layer)

mission.primary_objective: Implement protocol-native gas sponsorship on Flow so Ring users never hold or spend FLOW for routine participation, transfer, mint, or marketplace actions.
mission.context: Flow transactions separate Proposer, Authorizer, and Payer roles. Ring treasury (service account) acts as Payer while the user or app-controlled child account remains Proposer/Authorizer. This replaces EVM paymaster infrastructure for interim Ringdom deployment. Sponsor budgets and allowlisted Cadence templates prevent abuse.
mission.target_outcome: Every Ring-surface mutation uses a sponsored transaction pattern with deterministic fee accounting, compute limits, and auditable payer identity — users experience Web2-like checkout without gas prompts.
mission.scope: FCL/@onflow/react-sdk payer configuration, server-side authz for treasury account, compute limit selection, and sponsor policy — not Cadence contract authoring (see flow_cadence_* lenses).

truth_lens: Gas abstraction on Flow is a first-class protocol feature, not a bolt-on smart contract. The Payer account pays network fees in FLOW; Authorizers sign state changes; they need not be the same party. Ring must always set payer explicitly to treasury authz in production — never assume FCL defaults (current user pays) unless testing locally.
core_principles: Separate payer from user: treasury FLOW balance funds UX; project FT/NFT live in user vaults.
Simulate before submit: use FCL pre-flight or Access API dry-run where applicable; cap compute with explicit limits.
Allowlist Cadence templates: sponsor only known transaction bodies — no arbitrary user-supplied Cadence in hot paths.
Meter treasury spend: daily FLOW burn budgets, per-user rate limits, alert on anomaly.
Prefer onceExecuted over deprecated sealed patterns for lower latency (FCL v1.15+).
anti_patterns: Defaulting payer to fcl.authz / fcl.currentUser in production Ring flows.
Sponsoring unbounded arbitrary Cadence from client without server policy review.
Blind compute limit of 9999 on every tx — wastes treasury or causes aborts.
Storing payer private keys in client bundles or NEXT_PUBLIC env vars.
Assuming Flow Wallet auto-sponsor on mainnet covers third-party app txs without your own payer setup.
key_patterns: fcl.mutate({ cadence, proposer: userAuthz, authorizations: [userAuthz], payer: treasuryAuthz, limit: N }).
Server-side treasury authz: sign payer role with service account key from HSM/K8s secret — never expose to browser.
Compute limit heuristic: simple FT transfer ~50–100; NFT transfer ~100–200; complex marketplace tx profile on testnet first.
Flow EVM alternative: custom gateway with GAS_PRICE=0 and service account signing — only if Ring uses Flow EVM path.
consult_when: Designing gasless UX for Ring login, airdrop, vote, or NFT actions on Flow
Wiring treasury service account as transaction payer in FCL or react-sdk
Choosing compute limits and FLOW budget alerts for sponsored txs
Comparing Cadence sponsor vs Flow EVM sponsored RPC gateway
Debugging 'insufficient balance' on payer account vs authorizer account
expertise: FCL_PAYER_AUTHZ — treasury signing and mutate/send builders
COMPUTE_METERING — limit selection and abort handling

transaction_roles.proposer: Anti-replay nonce role; often the user or app child account.
transaction_roles.authorizer: Signs for accounts whose storage/contracts mutate; may include multiple parties.
transaction_roles.payer: Exactly one account pays FLOW fees; Ring treasury in production.
transaction_roles.disclaimer: Payer does not grant access to payer account storage — fees only.

compute_limit_guidance.disclaimer: Cadence meters compute units; Flow fees are generally low. Profile on testnet.

fcl_patterns.mutate_sponsored: await fcl.mutate({ cadence, proposer, authorizations, payer: treasuryAuthz, limit })

flow_evm_sponsored_gateway.note: Optional path if Ring uses Flow EVM: custom RPC gateway with GAS_PRICE=0; service account pays.

core_contract_addresses.disclaimer: Payer pays in FLOW; project tokens are separate FT contracts.

role: LegioX truth lens — Flow sponsored transactions and gas abstraction
